Kindle Paperwhite – 7“ Paperwhite display with high contrast ratio and fast page turns. Ready for travel – The ultra-thin design has a larger glare-free screen so pages stay sharp no matter where you are. Escape into your books – Your Kindle doesn’t have social media, notifications, or other distracting apps. Battery life for your longest novel – A single charge via USB-C lasts up to 12 weeks. Read in any light – Adjust the display from white to amber to read in bright sunlight or in the dark. Waterproof and worry-free – Take your stories by the pool, in the bath, or anywhere in between. Massive selection — Instantly access over 15 million titles in the Kindle Store worldwide, and add a Kindle+ subscription for instant access to millions of stories, including bestsellers. › See more product details
